# wallix-bastion_authdomain_ad (Data Source)

Provides information about an Active Directory authentication domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "wallix-bastion_authdomain_ad" "corporate" {
  domain_name      = "corporate.local"
  auth_domain_name = "corporate.com"
}

# Map a group of the directory to a user group of the Bastion
resource "wallix-bastion_authdomain_mapping" "admins" {
  domain_id      = data.wallix-bastion_authdomain_ad.corporate.id
  user_group     = "administrators"
  external_group = "CN=Bastion Admins,OU=Groups,DC=corporate,DC=local"
}

output "corporate_ad_domain" {
  value = {
    default_language     = data.wallix-bastion_authdomain_ad.corporate.default_language
    default_email_domain = data.wallix-bastion_authdomain_ad.corporate.default_email_domain
    external_auths       = data.wallix-bastion_authdomain_ad.corporate.external_auths
    secondary_auth       = data.wallix-bastion_authdomain_ad.corporate.secondary_auth
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `auth_domain_name` (String)
- `domain_name` (String)

### Optional

- `secondary_auth` (List of String)

### Read-Only

- `default_email_domain` (String)
- `default_language` (String)
- `external_auths` (List of String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `language_attribute` (String)

## Usage Notes

The domain is looked up by `domain_name`, its name on the Bastion; the data source fails when no
domain has this name. `auth_domain_name` is required too: set it to the `auth_domain_name` of the
domain (`wallix-bastion_authdomain_ad`).

`external_auths` lists the external authentications of the domain
(`wallix-bastion_externalauth_ldap`), and `secondary_auth` its secondary authentication methods.
